window.note: CODEMOTHER HAS A HAND, AND THIS CROSSING IS HER FIRST — made by her, on the ticket that gave it to her. Her shim answers a 'cross' verb that fires the harbor door over the bus with actor='codemother', so a crossing she admits says cleared by 'codemother' in the record of truth instead of 'CC'. Proved by three falsifier teeth: an accepted crossing whose fixture history reads actor=codemother; an unproven boat still REFUSED through her, carrying the door's own reason (a hand that can only say yes is not a gate); and zero harbor_master imports under her device, bus only. THE GATE THAT ALMOST STOPPED HER WAS HER OWN. cairn/devices/codemother/intention+why.json carried gated_by ['CC'], so the first boat she could not cross was her own component. Reported to Akien as a spec choice rather than fixed on my read; he ruled in six words -- 'her gate should admit her, fix it' -- and the ruling is on file at CairnCommons/decisions/2026-09-09-codemothers-own-gate-admits-her.json. gated_by is now ['codemother', 'CC'], a shape already standing at three other addresses. THREE BUGS THE VOYAGE UNCOVERED AND FIXED, under the bounds ruling 2026-09-09-a-bug-the-voyage-uncovers-is-fixed-by-that-voyage: reach() could not find a shim berthed under a machine tree; a shim handler that posts was handed its own envelope back forever, because the delivery receipt is written after deliver() returns; and read_history swallowed a non-list history silently. AND A FOURTH, THE LARGEST, FOUND BY THE PRE-COMMIT RESEAL LADDER RATHER THAN BY ME: chain.grammar.ticket_path globbed '*-<claim>.json' with nothing anchoring the left side, so any English word ENDING a ticket slug resolved to that ticket -- and reason_has_referent, the floor built to stop hollow exemptions, splits prose into words and offered each one. 'none, because we talked about it' passed on 'it'. Measured: 270 filed tickets, ZERO carry the id as a suffix, so the tail match never once served a real lookup; 364 exemption reasons, 321 passed before and 177 pass now. The floor built against one plausible sentence was certifying plausible sentences at 71%, and no proof anywhere judged it directly -- two doors and a gate each proved only that ITS door behaved. It has teeth of its own now, both channels hand-falsified. AND TIGHTENING IT EXPOSED A THIRD PATH CONVENTION nobody had written down: the ruling gate spells what_dies and what_conforms relative to the roots PARENT, because one ruling spans both trees. So a reason citing the very decision that settled it redded. 9 of the 196 reds were that, every one an honest referent redded for its spelling; the floor speaks all three now, 196 -> 187, with a tooth proving a roots-parent path to nothing still fails.

window.note: The seal announces itself, and the boat moves on the announcement. Twelve tickets stood at PROVEME on 2026-09-07 with a green seal already on the proof each named — not one blocked, each just waiting for a hand to remember. `cairn test --seal` now posts one `sealed` message per green seal; codemother finds the boat that named the proof and asks the HARBOR to cross it, as herself, through the same gate a hand would have met. THREE ENDS, THREE PROOFS: the telling (tester), the finding and the asking (codemother), the refusing (harbor). `proven_by` is read as one-or-many for exactly this reason, and this voyage taught the THIRD reader of that contract — transitions.inspect_clearance — what the other two already knew.
